{{Top|leg}}
A '''TIE Interceptor simulator module''' was a module used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on a [[TIE fighter simulator]] to simulate flying a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]], usually for training and learning purposes.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
